A '''female''' member of a [[Feline/Legends|felinoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] served as a member of [[Dorjander Kace]]'s [[Mandalorian Knights]]. Like [[Gender/Legends|her]] comrades she wore silver-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Neo-Crusader armor]] and wielded a bronze-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
